name: nlp_hf_classification_clean
title: The correct twin of nlp_hf_classification: seeded datasets split, a Pipeline baseline, an evaluated Trainer and an honest holdout pass
origin: hardening round 1, domain-nlp, 2026-09-13 - the false-positive trap for the whole HuggingFace family
note: Measured 0 findings and 0 diagnostics in both --dataflow local and --dataflow ip on 2026-09-13. Every forbidden row below names the nearest trap in the file rather than a rule that could never fire here.

forbidden.why: the only fit in this file is pipeline.fit(train_x, train_y) on line 55, after train_test_split on line 48 - the vectorizer lives inside the Pipeline and is refitted per fold
nothing is ever fitted on test_x or test_y; they are returned untouched for the caller to transform through the fitted pipeline
the estimator handed to any CV call here is a Pipeline, which is exactly the fix MLV103 asks for
encoded.train_test_split takes seed=SEED (line 39) and train_test_split takes random_state=SEED (line 48)
transformers.set_seed(SEED) is called at the top of build_trainer (line 22), and random_state=/seed= appear on both splits
np.argmax turns the logits into class ids on line 15 before accuracy_score and f1_score see them
roc_auc_score is given the softmax probability matrix, not predict() output
the Trainer has eval_dataset=split["test"], compute_metrics and eval_strategy="epoch"
the only DataLoader here is the holdout loader; the Trainer builds and shuffles the training batches
the holdout loader passes shuffle=False explicitly (line 51)
model.eval() is called on line 53, before the loop on line 57
the whole scoring loop sits inside with torch.no_grad() (line 56)
input_ids and labels are both moved with .to(device) on lines 58-59, before model() on line 60
the device is torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu") - the availability check MLV502 asks for is on the same line
torch.save is given model.state_dict(), not the module, and nothing in this project calls torch.load
there is no hand-written optimisation loop in this project at all
same - no backward() is written anywhere here
no nn.Module subclass is defined in this project
no submodule container is built here
